key_insight: GeoReplay preserves pretrained aerodynamic surrogate accuracy on source vehicles while matching fine-tuning accuracy on new vehicle classes.
engineering_relevance: This approach could reduce the need for separate CFD-based surrogate training campaigns while limiting accuracy loss on previously learned vehicle designs.
method: Benchmark five DrivAerML-pretrained surrogates on four independent target datasets.
Replay source simulations with geometries resembling the target vehicles.
Apply replay updates only when aligned with the target gradient.
evidence_signal: Across datasets differing in geometry, CFD solver, turbulence model, and flow conditions, fine-tuning beat training from scratch in fewer than half of comparisons; GeoReplay reduced source error relative to fine-tuning in 77 of 80 settings while matching target accuracy.
watch_item: GeoReplay requires access to source simulations, and its small-step target training guarantee does not establish zero-shot generalization or improved target test accuracy.
paper_title: Measuring and Improving Transfer of Neural Surrogates for Vehicle Aerodynamics
